title: Why URLs Matter
excerpt: A web address can remember which page you are viewing.
body: URLs make pages easy to revisit, refresh, and share with other people.

title: Meet React Router
excerpt: React Router connects web addresses to pages.
body: A router looks at the current address and helps the app show the matching page.

title: Building with Vite
excerpt: Vite helps you build and run a web project.
body: Vite gives developers a quick way to start a project and see their changes.

title: Your First React Page
excerpt: A React component describes part of the page.
body: You can build a page from small components, such as a heading, menu, and post card.

title: Shareable Filters
excerpt: Search values in the URL can remember a selected filter.
body: A URL such as /posts?tag=react can open the posts page with the React tag selected.
